meta.title: No exchange/market in the request -> exchanges + market pairs available from this broker.

slice.title: exchange/market both present in the request -> the instrument rows for that segment.

items.title: CatalogEntry.to_afb_dict() — a brief catalog row, not the full enriched instrument (see broker.instrument.json for that).

broker_symbol.description: Opaque broker-native locator (e.g. Finam's TICKER@MIC). Not the AFB `ticker`.

title: payload: broker.catalog
description: Response to broker.get_catalog. Describes the shape BF's InstrumentRegistry/CatalogStore actually emits today (belphegor/brokers/catalog_store.py CatalogMeta.to_dict() for the meta form, get_catalog_slice() for the slice form) — deliberately permissive (additionalProperties: true throughout, required kept to the minimum AFB reads) since BrokerPort.get_catalog_meta()/get_catalog_slice() impose nothing on a broker plugin's exact dict shape. This is a PATCH-level description of existing wire behavior, not a new constraint on it.
